title: maint.event.v1{kind=backup_offsite_upload_id_expired}
description: Phase 8 §8.16.5 — emitted by MultipartResumeManager when the persisted upload_id is stale (NoSuchUpload from ListParts, or state file age > maint_backup_offsite_state_max_age_h). The agent deletes the state file and restarts the upload from scratch. Notification-only.

original_upload_id.description: The stale upload_id that was discarded.

dump_date.description: ISO date of the backup dump being uploaded.

age_h.description: Age of the state file in hours at expiry time.

expiry_reason.description: Whether expiry was detected via ListParts or mtime check.
